description: Repro (0a1d44728 and with the fz-sc8.163 spike): dbg(Kernel.if(true, do: 1, else: 2)) -> error[resolve/unknown-import]: module Kernel does not export if/2. Elixir prints 1. In fz if is a special form, not a Kernel macro (no defmacro if in lib/), so the qualified name finds nothing. Not yet enumerated: which other Elixir Kernel macros are special forms in fz (unless, and, or, in, |> ...). Done when: the list is enumerated in this ticket, and an oracle fixture calls each by qualified name and matches Elixir on interp, run and build. Not on the distiller path.
title: Kernel.if and the other special forms are callable by their qualified name
